planets.name: HD 149026 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Ogma with a 2.88-day year, found in 2005.

text.card: HD 149026 b was found in 2005 by Subaru Telescope as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Ogma. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2005, disc_facility Subaru Telescope, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.8758885, pl_radj 0.74, pl_bmassj 0.38

quotes.title: HD 149026 b
quotes.card: HD 149026 b, also known as Smertrios, is an exoplanet, specifically a hot Jupiter, approximately 250 light-years from the Sun in the constellation of Hercules.
quotes.introduction: Its host star is HD 149026, also named Ogma.
